sentences.sentence: The frame number marks, made of steel plate shall be welded and painted on the hatch coaming and bulwark at the place of every 10 frame-space and at every bulkhead.

sentences.sentence: Determination of death in ectothermic animals may be more difficult due to differences in their physiology.
sentences.translation: 断定因安乐死死亡的动物可能更为困难因为不同的动物有不同的生理情况。

sentences.sentence: Unlike most terrestrial animals, aquatic animal species used for human consumption are poikilothermic, meaning their body temperatures vary according to ambient temperatures.
sentences.translation: 与大多数陆地动物不同，供人类消费的水生动物为冷血品种，也就是说它们的体温会根据环境温度而变化。

sentences.sentence: These indeed have new comparative features in terms of the tolerance, comparing with the organisms that do not need to maintain homeostasis, such as poikilothermic organisms.
sentences.translation: 这与那些不需要保持内稳态的生物如变温生物相比，的确在耐受性方面存在新的比较特点。

sentences.sentence: Amphibians and reptiles are poikilothermic and quite sensitive to the change of ambient temperature. They adapt to environmental temperature by means of self- thermoregulation .
sentences.translation: 两栖类和爬行类属于变温脊椎动物，它对外界环境温度的变化非常敏感，借助自身体温调节以适应或抵抗这种变化。

sentences.sentence: Since plants cannot locomote , the sensation of experiencing pain would be superfluous. Thus, plants differ completely physiologically from mammals.
sentences.translation: 由于植物无法移动，它们不太需要具备感知痛苦的能力，因此，植物与哺乳动物在生理上全然不同。

sentences.sentence: In simulation, millions of robotic modules assemble to form a large cube robot able to locomote in many types of environments.
sentences.translation: 在仿真方面，数以千计的机器人模块编译成一个可以在多种环境中移动的机器人。

sentences.sentence: The onetime heir apparent had played an instrumental role this year in propping up his father's rule and his crackdown against the rebellion that ultimately ended his 42-year grip on power.
sentences.translation: 曾一度作为卡扎菲继承人的赛义夫今年在巩固其父亲的统治并帮助镇压反抗武装一事中起到积极作用。 这场反抗活动最终结束了卡扎菲对利比亚42年的统治。

sentences.sentence: ...a 50-minute manifesto with citations from the Koran.
sentences.translation: …一段长达50分钟、带有《古兰经》引文的宣言。

sentences.sentence: This is your true nature, one of effortless peace and stillness.
sentences.translation: 这就是你的本质，一个完全不需费力的平静和静止。

sentences.sentence: As it is, I enjoy with something of sadness remembering that this melodious silence is but the prelude of that deeper stillness which waits to enfold us all.
sentences.translation: 实际上，我带着几分悲伤喜欢回忆起这种悦耳的沉默只是比较深层的寂静的前奏，它等待着要把我们所有的人笼罩起来。

sentences.sentence: He had a problem with his eyesight.
sentences.translation: 他的视力有问题。

sentences.sentence: The note of pure panic in his voice was almost comical.
sentences.translation: 他那种十分慌张的口气几乎有点滑稽。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 457 单元

tonnage
音标：英 /'tʌnɪdʒ/  美 /'tʌnɪdʒ/
n. 登记吨位, 排水量
短语：gross tonnage — 总吨位
例句：A huge tonnage of bombs has already been dropped on the area.
巨大吨数的炸弹已被投到该地区。

seagoing
音标：英 /'siːgəʊɪŋ/  美 /'sɪ'goɪŋ/
adj. 适于远航的,出海的
例句：a seagoing ship
远洋轮

jacket
音标：英 /'dʒækɪt/  美 /'dʒækɪt/
n. 夹克,护封
v. 给穿夹克
短语：leather jacket — 皮夹克
短语：water jacket — 水套
短语：down jacket — 羽绒服；鸭绒衣；羽绒夹克
短语：life jacket — 救生衣
短语：cooling jacket — [机]冷却套管
短语：yellow jacket — n. 黄马褂；小黄蜂
短语：dust jacket — n. 书皮；包书纸
短语：heating jacket — 加热套
短语：dinner jacket — 晚礼服；无尾礼服；小礼服；礼服夹克（等于tuxedo）
短语：sports jacket — 猎装；便装上衣；（男子在非正式场合穿的）粗花呢西装外套
短语：waterproof jacket — 防水密外套；防水夹克
短语：cooling water jacket — 冷却水套
短语：cable jacket — 电缆外壳；电缆套管
例句：...a black leather jacket.
…一件黑色皮夹克。

fisherman
音标：英 /'fɪʃəmən/  美 /'fɪʃɚmən/
n. 渔民, 渔夫
例句：The Algarve is a paradise for fishermen whether river anglers or deep-sea fishermen.
阿尔加维对河边的垂钓者或深海的渔民都是一个天堂。

mainsheet
音标：英 /'meɪnʃiːt/  美 /'men,ʃit/
n. 主桅帆操纵索

oblivious
音标：英 /ə'blɪvɪəs/  美 /ə'blɪvɪəs/
adj. 没注意到, 健忘的
例句：She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain.
她一动不动地躺在原地，感觉不到疼痛。

coaming
音标：英 /'kəʊmɪŋ/  美 /'komɪŋ/
n. 舱口栏板, 边材
例句：The acetic acid is corrosive. Please put them in both sides of No. 5 deck, leaving a passage between the hatch coaming and the cargo.
醋酸（乙酸）有腐蚀性，请把其装在五舱甲板两边，在货物和舱口围板间留一条通道。
例句：The frame number marks, made of steel plate shall be welded and painted on the hatch coaming and bulwark at the place of every 10 frame-space and at every bulkhead.
每隔10档肋位和每一舱壁处要用钢板割的肋位标记焊接到舱口围和舷墙上。

lad
音标：英 /læd/  美 /læd/
n. 少年, 青年男子
例句：a young lad
小伙子
例句：Things were different when I was a lad.
我年轻的时候，情况可不大相同。

tilt
音标：英 /tɪlt/  美 /tɪlt/
v. (使)倾斜, 以言词或文字抨击
短语：tilt angle — 倾斜角
短语：tilt table — 倾斜台；摆动升降台
短语：at full tilt — 全速地；全力以赴地
例句：My mother tilted her head and smiled.
我妈妈歪着头笑了。
例句：Ned’s mouth tilted upwards slightly at the corners.
内德的嘴角微微翘起。

choppy
音标：英 /'tʃɒpɪ/  美 /'tʃɑpi/
adj. （海等）波浪起伏的, (指风)不断改变方向的
例句：The small boat bobbed about on the choppy water.
小船在波浪起伏的水面上颠簸。

illustrator
音标：英 /'ɪləstreɪtə/  美 /'ɪləstretɚ/
n. 插图画家,说明者
例句：Called up for military service, Mr. Marokvia spent the war as an illustrator for the Wehrmacht, applying brush and pencil in Ukraine, Italy, Finland and Yugoslavia.
玛洛克维亚先生被征召入伍，他作为一名德国国防军的插图画家，在乌克兰、意大利、芬兰和南斯拉夫留下了自己的墨迹。

ectothermic
n. 变温动物
例句：Determination of death in ectothermic animals may be more difficult due to differences in their physiology.
断定因安乐死死亡的动物可能更为困难因为不同的动物有不同的生理情况。

poikilothermic
adj. [动]变温的, 冷血动物的
例句：Unlike most terrestrial animals, aquatic animal species used for human consumption are poikilothermic, meaning their body temperatures vary according to ambient temperatures.
与大多数陆地动物不同，供人类消费的水生动物为冷血品种，也就是说它们的体温会根据环境温度而变化。
例句：These indeed have new comparative features in terms of the tolerance, comparing with the organisms that do not need to maintain homeostasis, such as poikilothermic organisms.
这与那些不需要保持内稳态的生物如变温生物相比，的确在耐受性方面存在新的比较特点。
例句：Amphibians and reptiles are poikilothermic and quite sensitive to the change of ambient temperature. They adapt to environmental temperature by means of self- thermoregulation .
两栖类和爬行类属于变温脊椎动物，它对外界环境温度的变化非常敏感，借助自身体温调节以适应或抵抗这种变化。

locomote
v. 移动, 行动
例句：Since plants cannot locomote , the sensation of experiencing pain would be superfluous. Thus, plants differ completely physiologically from mammals.
由于植物无法移动，它们不太需要具备感知痛苦的能力，因此，植物与哺乳动物在生理上全然不同。
例句：In simulation, millions of robotic modules assemble to form a large cube robot able to locomote in many types of environments.
在仿真方面，数以千计的机器人模块编译成一个可以在多种环境中移动的机器人。

inadequately
adv. 不够地,  不够好

onetime
adj. 从前的,  一度的
adv. 从前
例句：The onetime heir apparent had played an instrumental role this year in propping up his father's rule and his crackdown against the rebellion that ultimately ended his 42-year grip on power.
曾一度作为卡扎菲继承人的赛义夫今年在巩固其父亲的统治并帮助镇压反抗武装一事中起到积极作用。 这场反抗活动最终结束了卡扎菲对利比亚42年的统治。

citation
音标：英 /saɪ'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /saɪ'teʃən/
n. 引用,表扬
短语：citation index — 引文索引；引证索引
短语：science citation index — 科学文献索引
例句：...a 50-minute manifesto with citations from the Koran.
…一段长达50分钟、带有《古兰经》引文的宣言。

stillness
音标：英 /'stɪlnɪs/  美 /'stɪlnəs/
n. 静止, 沉静
例句：This is your true nature, one of effortless peace and stillness.
这就是你的本质，一个完全不需费力的平静和静止。
例句：As it is, I enjoy with something of sadness remembering that this melodious silence is but the prelude of that deeper stillness which waits to enfold us all.
实际上，我带着几分悲伤喜欢回忆起这种悦耳的沉默只是比较深层的寂静的前奏，它等待着要把我们所有的人笼罩起来。

eyesight
音标：英 /'aɪsaɪt/  美 /'aɪsaɪt/
n. 视力, 目力
短语：poor eyesight — 视力很差；视力差
例句：He had a problem with his eyesight.
他的视力有问题。

comical
音标：英 /'kɒmɪk(ə)l/  美 /'kɑmɪkl/
adj. 好笑的, 滑稽的
例句：The note of pure panic in his voice was almost comical.
他那种十分慌张的口气几乎有点滑稽。
